headline: PM Shehbaz Sharif on Monday condemned Israeli restrictions on humanitarian aid reaching Gaza, where rains flooded about 70,000 tents over the weekend, and directed the Foreign Ministry to escalate humanitarian assistance urgently.

card.desc: PM condemns Israeli limits on aid reaching Gaza.

caption:
PM Shehbaz Sharif orders more help for Gaza!
According to Arab News, PM Shehbaz Sharif on Monday condemned Israeli restrictions that stop humanitarian aid from reaching Gaza. He directed the Foreign Ministry to use all possible means to increase aid urgently. Save the Children said about 70,000 tents of displaced Palestinians were flooded in a single day over the weekend.
